zh.ABSTRACT: 本文复现 SWE-Pruner: Self-Adaptive Context Pruning for Coding Agents 中基于 0.6B neural skimmer 的工具输出剪枝方法。代码对象为作者仓库的 OpenHands/SWE-QA 评测流程：OpenHands 执行代码搜索与读取，SWE-QA 提供仓库问答及参考答案评分。数值目标是原论文表 2 中 Streamlink、GLM-4.6 的完整观测与 SWE-Pruner 两行，原文评分均为 8.56，平均累计 tokens 从 318.2K 降至 145.1K（−54.4%）。本次在预选八题上运行三条件、各三次，共完成 72 项；完整与剪枝组评分为 8.63／9.27，平均累计 tokens 为 112.8K／131.0K（+16.1%）。实际剪枝文本压缩 76.5%，端到端 token 变化方向与原文相反，显示局部压缩收益受到后续调查路径影响。本文新增任务级原始观测存储与有界行范围恢复。自主 QA 中，恢复相对剪枝的评分变化为 −0.13、tokens 增加 6.8%；另一个 72 项目标变化实验中，正确数由剪后观测的 3/24 提升至 24/24，总 tokens 从 20,655 增至 55,617。改进实现了遗漏证据的精确恢复，其任务收益取决于读取策略和交互成本。
zh.CASE_ANALYSIS:
剪枝组在 10/24 个任务中实际调用 skimmer，共 16 次，将这些输出的 268,659 个源 tokens 保留为 63,009 个，压缩 76.5%。恢复组在 4/24 个任务中剪枝。自主选择使各组读代码的路径也发生变化。

按每题三次均值选择 token 降幅最大的 q30 和增幅最大的 q11。q30 的完整／剪枝均值为 249.8K／167.6K；第 1 次执行中，page.py 的 54,349 个源 tokens 被剪到 13,107，最大输入从 40,427 降到 18,258，API 调用为 11／10。长文件压缩在这一轨迹中转化为累计节省。

q11 的完整／剪枝均值为 358.2K／520.4K，三次剪枝组均未填写关注问题。第 3 次执行对整个 CDP 目录递归搜索 from_json 及事件解析，持续读取完整结果；最大输入达到 43,299，累计 826,860 tokens，完整组对应为 15,306 和 305,129。这个差异反映工具选择及调查路径。事后逐题影响检查中，移除 q11 后其余七题的 token 差为 −2.4K；主统计仍保留全部八题，95% 区间跨越增减两个方向。
zh.JUDGE_ANALYSIS: 评分提升集中于 q41：完整／剪枝均值为 5.00／8.53。题目要求定位 TestIO 的 test_load_data；完整组答案先讲 Cache 实现，再提测试，剪枝组直接定位测试方法。第 1 次完整答案得 4.6 分，虽包含正确的 dirty 机制，仍偏离了问题的定位重点。保留原始评分；事后移除 q41 后，评分差从 +0.63 变为 +0.22，说明单题与回答粒度对均值影响显著。
zh.CONCLUSIONS:
已运行作者工具链并验证长观测压缩行为。在本八题子集中，剪枝将实际处理的源文本压缩 76.5%，最终累计 tokens 增加 16.1%，评分提高 0.63。论文的整体节省幅度在本地样本中表现为不同的资源权衡，q11 的长调查轨迹对均值影响最大。

精确恢复在固定目标变化测试中把正确数从 3/24 提升到 24/24；自主 QA 中，相对剪枝组 tokens 增加 6.8%，平均评分变化 −0.13，评分差区间跨零。轨迹同时呈现补回缺失证据与重建整个文件两种行为。

扩大题目覆盖，并在开发集上明确恢复预算、索引和停止策略，再冻结测试。后续研究可沿用任务级存储接口，比较结构化记录的投影与切片，测量证据覆盖、重复读取及总交互成本。

en.ABSTRACT: We reproduce the 0.6B neural-skimmer method in SWE-Pruner: Self-Adaptive Context Pruning for Coding Agents using its released OpenHands/SWE-QA code. OpenHands executes repository exploration; SWE-QA supplies repository questions and reference-based scoring. The numerical target is Table 2's Streamlink/GLM-4.6 full-observation and SWE-Pruner rows: both score 8.56, while mean cumulative tokens fall from 318.2K to 145.1K (−54.4%). We complete 72 runs across eight selected questions, three conditions and three executions. Full/pruned observations score 8.63/9.27 and use 112.8K/131.0K mean tokens (+16.1%). Processed tool text shrinks 76.5%, while end-to-end token use changes in the opposite direction to the published result. Our modification adds task-scoped original-observation storage and bounded exact line recovery. In autonomous QA, recovery changes score by −0.13 and increases tokens 6.8% relative to pruning. In a separate 72-run goal-shift study, exact matches improve from 3/24 to 24/24, with total tokens rising from 20,655 to 55,617. The modification restores omitted evidence; its downstream utility depends on retrieval decisions and interaction cost.
en.CASE_ANALYSIS:
Pruning activates in 10/24 tasks: 16 calls reduce 268,659 source tokens to 63,009, a 76.5% reduction. Recovery activates pruning in 4/24 tasks. Autonomous choices also change repository-reading paths.

We inspect q30 and q11, the largest mean token decrease and increase. For q30, full/pruned means are 249.8K/167.6K. In repetition 1, page.py shrinks from 54,349 source tokens to 13,107; peak input falls from 40,427 to 18,258, with 11/10 API calls. Local compression translates into cumulative savings on this trajectory.

For q11, full/pruned means are 358.2K/520.4K; all three pruning-condition executions omit the focus question. Repetition 3 recursively searches the CDP directory for deserializers and event parsing, repeatedly carrying full results. Peak input reaches 43,299 and total tokens 826,860, versus 15,306 and 305,129 for full observations. This reflects tool selection and investigation paths. A post-hoc influence check omitting q11 gives a −2.4K token difference across the other seven questions. Primary statistics retain all eight; the token interval spans both directions.
en.JUDGE_ANALYSIS: The score gain concentrates in q41: full/pruned means are 5.00/8.53. The question asks for TestIO.test_load_data; full answers foreground production Cache logic, while pruned answers directly locate the test. The first full answer scores 4.6 despite explaining the dirty mechanism correctly. Original scores remain unchanged. Omitting q41 in a post-hoc influence check changes the score difference from +0.63 to +0.22, illustrating sensitivity to one question and answer granularity.
en.CONCLUSIONS:
The released pipeline executes and compresses long observations. In this eight-question subset, source text processed by the skimmer shrinks 76.5%, while cumulative tokens increase 16.1% and score rises 0.63. The local resource trade-off differs from the paper's aggregate saving; q11's investigation trajectory has the largest influence.

Exact recovery improves goal-shift correctness from 3/24 to 24/24. Autonomous QA instead uses 6.8% more tokens than pruning and changes score by −0.13, with a score interval spanning zero. Traces show both missing-evidence retrieval and full-file reconstruction.

Broaden question coverage and define retrieval budgets, indexing and stopping policies on development data before freezing evaluation. Future work can reuse task-scoped storage and compare structured-record projection and slicing through evidence coverage, repeated reads and total interaction cost.
